newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BOLAND, SAMGRO SIMPLIFY CAPITAL STRUCTURES.
newsitem.headline: BOLAND, SAMGRO SIMPLIFY CAPITAL STRUCTURES.

text.p: Boland Bank Holdings Ltd and Samgro Investment Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday they would be converting their linked units into ordinary shares to simplify the capital structures of both groups.

Each Samgro linked unit, consisting of a debenture and a deferred "N" ordinary share, would be converted into two "N" ordinary shares and each Boland unit, made up of a debenture and a deferred ordinary share, into two Boland shares, they said.
Linked units would be delisted from the Johannesburg Stock Exchange at the same time as the new ordinary shares were listed.

The conversion would result in the market value of the two Boland shares increasing to 90.40 rand from 82 rand, its price on November 19. The two Samgro "N" shares would rise by 470 cents to 16 rand from 11.30 previously, the statement said.
